items.title: A Mid-40s Tech Worker’s $882,000 of Deferred Pay Would Arrive Over Five Years. Each Year Could Rule Out an ACA Credit
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA married Reddit poster in their mid-40s who is weighing a big-tech buyout has $882,000 of deferred pay due over about five years, or $176,400 a year if it’s paid evenly. Marketplace coverage gets the Premium Tax Credit only if household income is no more than 400% of the federal poverty line, and that cap applies again for tax years after 2025.
